law.catch_line: Cancellation of sick benefit portion of policy
law.text:
Every policy of industrial sick benefit insurance issued in this Commonwealth after June 18, 1922, shall contain a provision that:
The sick benefit portion of the policy may be cancelled by either the insurer or the insured and the life portion continued by a payment of twenty percent of the original premium;
If the cancellation is by the insurer, it shall be without prejudice to any claim arising on account of disability commencing prior to the date on which the cancellation takes effect; and
Written notice of the cancellation and payment for the unearned portion of the premium shall be delivered to the insured or mailed to him at his last known address.
